import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] C;
    static int r, c;
    static long total;
    static long min_diff = (long)1e18;
    static long min_z = -1;
    static char[] s;
    static int[] countA, countB;
    static Map<Long, Long> memo_map = new HashMap<>();

    static long[][] computeC(int size) {
        long[][] C = new long[size + 1][size + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= size; j++) {
                if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
                else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static void search(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (min_diff <= 1 || diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= min_diff) {
            return;
        }
        if (v1 == r - 1 && v2 == r - 1) {
            long current_diff = Math.abs(x - y);
            if (current_diff < min_diff) {
                min_diff = current_diff;
                min_z = x;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (v1 >= r) {
            long delta1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long sum2 = C[v2][r];
            search(x, y + delta1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= r) {
            long sum1 = C[v1][r];
            long delta2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            search(x + sum1 * delta2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    static long recurse(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long state_id = x * 10000L + v1 * 100L + v2;
        if (memo_map.containsKey(state_id)) {
            return memo_map.get(state_id);
        }
        long res = 0;
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > min_diff) {
            memo_map.put(state_id, res);
            return res;
        }
        if (v1 < r || v2 < r) {
            int sum = v1 + v2;
            if (v1 >= countA[sum] && v2 >= countB[sum]) {
                v1 -= countA[sum];
                v2 -= countB[sum];
                res = C[v1][v2][0]; // Correction: C[v1][v2] is 2D, but in Java, C is 2D array
            } else {
                res = 0;
            }
            memo_map.put(state_id, res);
            return res;
        }
        res = 0;
        char ch = s[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (ch != 'B') {
            long delta1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long sum2 = C[v2][r];
            res += recurse(x, y + delta1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (ch != 'A') {
            long sum1 = C[v1][r];
            long delta2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            res += recurse(x + sum1 * delta2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        memo_map.put(state_id, res);
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int size = 2 * (r + c);
        C = computeC(size);

        total = C[r + c][r] * C[r + c][r];

        long x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
        while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
            if (x > y) {
                long delta1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
                long sum2 = C[v2][r];
                y += delta1 * sum2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long sum1 = C[v1][r];
                long delta2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
                x += sum1 * delta2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        min_diff = Math.abs(x - y);

        search(0, 0, r + c, r + c);

        s = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        int len = s.length;
        countA = new int[len + 1];
        countB = new int[len + 1];
        countA[0] = 0;
        countB[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            countA[i + 1] = countA[i] + (s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            countB[i + 1] = countB[i] + (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        long answer2 = recurse(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        System.out.println(answer2);
    }
}
